preconditions.description: The number of hashtags n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(hashtag[0] == '#' and hashtag[1:].islower() for hashtag in hashtags)
preconditions.description: Each hashtag must start with '#' followed by lowercase letters.
The total length of all hashtags excluding the '#' must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(hashtags[i] <= hashtags[i + 1] for i in range(len(hashtags) - 1))
postconditions.description: The resulting hashtags must be in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: any(hashtags[i] != original_hashtags[i] for i in range(len(hashtags)))
postconditions.description: At least one hashtag must be modified.

postconditions.expression: sum(len(hashtag) - 1 for hashtag in hashtags) <= sum(len(original_hashtag) - 1 for original_hashtag in original_hashtags)
postconditions.description: The total number of deleted symbols must be minimized.

candidate_issues.task_evidence: Vasya is allowed to delete any number of characters, even the whole string except for the symbol '#'.
